# pathutil

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/apptide/internal/pathutil"
```

Package pathutil manages the Windows user PATH environment variable.

<a name="AddToUserPath"></a>
## func [AddToUserPath](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/apptide/blob/main/internal/pathutil/path.go#L28>)

```go
func AddToUserPath(dir string) error
```

AddToUserPath appends dir to the user\-level PATH in the Windows registry via PowerShell's \[Environment\]::SetEnvironmentVariable. The change persists across reboots but takes effect in new shells only.

<a name="IsInUserPath"></a>

```go
func IsInUserPath(dir string) bool
```

IsInUserPath reports whether dir is already present in the current process PATH.
